title: Thessaly Test
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask the patient to stand and support themselves by holding your hands or a stable surface.
Do not perform it in a knee that cannot bear weight or that is acutely locked.
Say that the test is performed at a stated flexion angle, because the angle changes which part of the meniscus is loaded, and that the angle should be recorded.
After a repair the test loads the repair and should not be used during the protected period.
